title: PAR-07/S8 DataIndex record-segment kind guard
mode: ODA-guided local parser correction with generated fast regression
scope: Constrain DataIndex rows to record-bearing Data segments
Reject Blob01 page segments as DataIndex record targets
Preserve valid neighboring records and the independent Blob01 page-reference route

localCodeInspection: src/drw_datastorage.cpp::isDataSegment previously returned true for both Data and Blob segment kinds and readDataRecords used it to admit DataIndex targets
tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp::testDataStorageRecordCountAlignmentAnchors already generated four records, unordered DataIndex rows, explicit payload anchors, and exact payload/owner links
method.limitations: Generated bytes prove this parser rejects a wrong-kind DataIndex target and retains valid neighbors. The control is not a valid producer-authored Blob01 page sample and does not qualify blob-page reconstruction, arbitrary DWG producer compatibility, ACIS semantics, or a native consumer.

formatBasis.authority: ODA §24.2.2.2 states that DataIndex entries index objects in the Data file segment and their local offsets point to a data file segment. §24.2.2.3 describes blob references within data records; §24.2.2.4 identifies the separate Blob01 page segments referenced by those descriptors.
formatBasis.expectedDisposition: A nonzero DataIndex row resolving to Blob01 or another non-Data segment is structurally invalid and must not be interpreted as a data-record header/payload. Segment-index zero is the documented stub row and remains ignored. Valid rows to Data segments remain readable.

behavior: Renamed the predicate to isDataRecordSegment and restricted it to DRW_DataStorageSegmentKind::Data; Blob remains allowed only through the descriptor's explicit Blob01 page-reference validation.
readDataRecords emits datastorage-record-segment-kind-invalid for nonzero DataIndex rows whose segment is not Data and ignores the ODA-defined segment-index-zero stub row.

The generated AC1027 profile now includes a fourth blob01 segment. Its negative control redirects one DataIndex row there and fills the location with plausible record-header/payload bytes, then requires structural invalidity, non-replayability, no redirected record, and exact payload retention for the other three records.

A companion control redirects one row to segment index zero with nonzero local-offset and schema-index fields; it requires the stub row to be ignored without a kind diagnostic, preserves structural replayability, and retains the other three payloads.

validation.commitBlocker: The shared worktree contains extensive existing user changes; no files were staged.

decision.nextAction: Self-unblock to the next ODA-backed local DataStorage invariant after auditing its existing generated controls; keep native and independent semantic evidence at the composed checkpoint.
